emma-cs: FYI CobaltThera raised a support ticket overnight: onboarding test traffic saw intermittent 502s and p95 latency ballooned. They want SLO evidence and a provisional credit calc before the renewal review next Tues. can ops produce a one-page bundle?
rafael-ops: on it. initial glance: overall uptime for their org 99.4% last 7d, but two small windows with elevated errors: 2026-01-18 02:34-02:47 UTC (502 surge) and 2026-01-20 05:12-05:20 UTC (latency tail). suspect routing churn + a small autoscale gap. linking runbook: https://console.redwood.ai/runbooks/onboarding-errors
taylor-sre: saw the 02:34 window in the logs. root cause appears to be a health-check flapping caused by a misconfigured readiness probe during a canary job. there was also a model swap at 02:30. recommendation: pin readiness timeout and disable aggressive canary for this route.
emma-cs: can we get exact numbers for the bundle: per-route uptime table, p50/p95/p99, failed request count, and trace ids for top 5 errors? keep it <1 page for customer.
rafael-ops: will produce metrics.csv + short incident.md + trace-list.txt. command I used: ```redwood-slo extract --org cobaltthera --from 2026-01-14 --to 2026-01-21 --format csv --include traces,errors``` ETA 25m.
deploy-bot: Deploy 2026-01-18_02:29:53 by @release-ci started: canary->primary (route: cobaltthera-onboard) :truck:  
taylor-sre: adding blurb for incident.md: "01/18 02:30 UTC: canary model rollout with insufficient readiness probe caused transient health-check failures leading to elevated 502s and increased tail latency for ~13 minutes. Mitigations: reverted canary, extended readiness timeout, added a 2-instance autoscale buffer. Follow-up: improve deploy gating and add a synthetic canary test for onboarding routes."
finance-ops-bot: provisional credit formula applied. inputs: uptime shortfall (0.6%), affected request volume (12k requests/week), ratecard multiplier -> provisional credit = "$1,750". This is preliminary pending sales/finance approval.
emma-cs: perfect. i'll draft the customer note: short apology, attached evidence bundle, proposed credit amount, offer 15-min walkthrough. sending to @sales-ops for signoff and will loop legal if they accept.
rafael-ops: uploaded bundle: https://s3.redwood.ai/cobaltthera/evidence/1755556789-cobalt-bundle.zip (metrics.csv, incident.md, traces.txt, credit_calc.md).
emma-cs: thanks team. i'll schedule the walkthrough and flag renewal risk to the AE. :calendar:
